pre_ipo_investors: Cumbre Entities (Cumbre, Big Bend 77/72; Series A Jun 2013 onward; 18.82% pre-offering)
China Life Sciences Access Fund, WuXi Fund (WuXi AppTec), Relativity Healthcare (Series C)
Frontline Bioventures entities, Suzhou Origin, Suzhou Oriza (Series C, Sep 2016)
other Series D/E investors incl. Qianrong Yingrun, Mr. William J. Rieflin (former Cumbre Inc. director)
board_roster_reviewed: Board at listing (6): Dr. Ma Zhenkun (executive, founder/chair) - no investor link; Dr. Song Gaoguang (NED since Jun 2022; partner at Northern Light Venture Capital Consulting (Beijing) - probable but not explicitly stated link to Pre-IPO investor Northern Light Venture; not relied on); Mr. Michael James Bakes (NED since Jul 8, 2025) - explicitly recommended as candidate by Cumbre (Pre-IPO investor) - LINKED; INEDs Lee Wai Kong, Ni Lin (former VC senior partner, no identified investor link), Li Leping (received 200,000 nil-consideration shares in 2013, repurchased 2014; no investor link) - not linked.
rights_and_timing: Before Jul 2025 the investors held contractual rights to appoint one Director each (Ma two), under a Voting Arrangement that was terminated after the Jul 11, 2025 shareholders' meeting; other special rights ceased on submission of the Listing application (redemption rights ceased May 22, 2025). At listing, Bakes' seat traces to Cumbre's recommendation (a nomination-type link, though not described as a continuing contractual right). No observer right found (no 'observer' hit in the prospectus).

evidence.quote: Our Board currently consists of six Directors, comprising one executive Director, two non-executive Directors and three independent non-executive Directors.
evidence.supports: Board at listing: 6 directors (Ma; NEDs Song Gaoguang, Bakes; INEDs Lee, Ni, Li).

evidence.quote: Upon the recommendation by Cumbre to the Company as a Director candidate, Mr. Bakes was elected and appointed by the general meeting as a Director.
evidence.supports: Bakes (NED since July 8, 2025) was recommended as director candidate by Cumbre.
evidence.interpretation: Seat explicitly linked to an identified Pre-IPO investor (Cumbre).

evidence.quote: Our Pre-IPO Investors include sophisticated investor, namely WuXi AppTec Co., Ltd. (無錫藥明康 德新藥開發股份有限公司)
evidence.supports: Introduces principal Pre-IPO investors list, first being the Cumbre Entities.

evidence.quote: Cumbre is a limited partnership organized and existing under the laws of the State of Texas (United States) and is managed by its general partner, 2M InvestCo LLC.
evidence.supports: Cumbre is listed among 'principal Pre-IPO Investors' (Cumbre Entities, 18.82% pre-offering).
evidence.interpretation: Confirms Cumbre is a Pre-IPO investor institution.

evidence.quote: Cumbre, which was wholly owned by Mr. Morton H Meyerson, agreed to purchase and TenNor Cayman agreed to issue 3,925,000 series A preferred shares of TenNor Cayman
evidence.supports: Cumbre invested in the Series A Financing (June 2013).

evidence.quote: Dr. Ma shall have the right to appoint two Directors and each of the other seven investors shall have the right to appoint one Director.
evidence.supports: Pre-listing voting arrangement: each of seven investors had a right to appoint one Director; the Board had up to nine seats.
evidence.interpretation: Pre-listing appointment rights existed for investors (seats held by investor-appointed directors).

evidence.quote: The Voting Arrangement has been terminated after the Shareholders’ meeting on July 11, 2025
evidence.supports: Investor director-appointment arrangement terminated July 2025, before listing.
evidence.interpretation: Right terminated pre-listing; seat held by Bakes remains at listing via Cumbre recommendation.

evidence.quote: Dr. Song Gaoguang (宋高廣), aged 42, was appointed as a non-executive Director on June 29, 2022, responsible for providing strategic advice to our Group.
evidence.supports: Song Gaoguang is NED since June 2022.
evidence.interpretation: Candidate; partner at Northern Light Venture Capital Consulting (Beijing), an affiliate-name of Pre-IPO investor Northern Light Venture, but the prospectus does not explicitly tie them; not relied on.

evidence.quote: Northern Light Venture Capital IV, Ltd. (“Northern Light Venture”), Relativity Healthcare Fund, LLC (“Relativity Healthcare”), China Life and WuXi Fund entered into the series C preferred share purchase agreement
evidence.supports: Northern Light Venture invested in Series C (Sep 2016).
evidence.interpretation: Secondary: Song's employer bears the same brand, but no explicit statement.
